column3: Add a period at the end of every complete sentence you write.
He piled mashed potatoes and chicken onto his dinner plate.
Analysts project that sales will double within the next five years.
He paid for the candy with three quarters and one dime.
The reporter interviewed the famous scientist about her new discovery.
She underlined every important sentence in the long paragraph.
The tall tree's shadow covered most of the backyard by evening.
He gave a hand signal to tell the driver to stop.
She explained the difficult math problem simply so everyone understood.
